title: Fix first admin authentication and build complete admin dashboard with server and plan management

requirements.text: Fix the first admin authentication logic so that the first user to sign in with Internet Identity is automatically recognized and granted admin status without requiring an invitation code

quotes: Yes please fix the authentication logic so you're properly recognized as the first admin

acceptanceCriteria: First authenticated user is automatically granted admin privileges
Admin status persists across sessions
No invitation code required for first admin
Subsequent users require invitation codes to become admins

requirements.text: Create an admin dashboard page that displays comprehensive lists of all dedicated servers with their current status, specifications, and assignment information

quotes: Dashboard should display a list of servers and plans with management capabilities
Full dashboard with the dedicated servers and plan etc

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows all servers in a table or card layout
Each server displays status (active, inactive, pending)
Server specs are visible (CPU, RAM, storage)
Assignment information shows which user or plan owns each server
Dashboard is only accessible to admin users

requirements.text: Implement server creation functionality allowing admins to create new dedicated servers by specifying name, specifications (CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB), and initial status

quotes: Server management needs create, assign, delete, and view status functions

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access a 'Create Server' form or dialog
Form includes fields for server name, CPU cores, RAM amount, storage capacity
Server is created with 'available' status by default
New server appears in the dashboard list immediately after creation
Backend persists the new server data

requirements.text: Implement server assignment functionality allowing admins to assign servers to specific user accounts or to subscription plans, with the flexibility to choose either assignment type based on customer needs

quotes: For server assignment - should admins assign servers to specific user accounts, or to purchased plans/subscriptions?
Yes to both depending on the required for the customer

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a server and choose to assign it to a user or a plan
Dropdown or search interface to select target user by name/email
Dropdown or search interface to select target plan
Assigned servers show their assignment in the dashboard
Backend tracks assignment type (user or plan) and target ID
Servers can be reassigned or unassigned

requirements.text: Implement server deletion functionality allowing admins to permanently remove servers from the system with confirmation to prevent accidental deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button or action available for each server in the dashboard
Confirmation dialog appears before deletion
Deletion removes server from backend storage
Deleted server disappears from dashboard immediately
Cannot delete servers that are currently assigned (or requires force delete confirmation)

requirements.text: Create a subscription plans management interface displaying all plans with their pricing, specifications, and billing periods, accessible from the admin dashboard

quotes: Displays a list of servers, plans, away to manage them
For Plans management - what information should each plan include?

acceptanceCriteria: Plans are displayed in a table or card layout in the admin dashboard
Each plan shows name, price, CPU/RAM/storage specs, and billing period
Plans section is organized separately from servers section
Admin can view all active and inactive plans

requirements.text: Implement plan creation and editing functionality allowing admins to define subscription plans with name, price, server specifications (CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB), and billing period (monthly, quarterly, annually)

quotes: what information should each plan include? (e.g., name, price, server specs like CPU/RAM/storage, billing period?)

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create new plans via a form or dialog
Form includes fields for plan name, price amount, CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB
Billing period selector with options: Monthly, Quarterly, Annually
Admin can edit existing plans
Changes to plans are reflected in the frontend Plans page for customers
Backend persists plan data

requirements.text: Integrate Stripe API for payment processing, allowing admins to configure Stripe secret key and for users to purchase subscription plans through Stripe checkout

quotes: For Stripe integration - should admins create/manage subscription plans that users can purchase?

acceptanceCriteria: Stripe secret key configuration interface accessible to admins (already exists in StripeSetupModal)
Users can select a plan and initiate checkout
Checkout redirects to Stripe for payment processing
Successful payments create orders/subscriptions in the backend
Payment success and failure pages handle redirect flows
Backend validates Stripe webhook signatures for security

constraints: Preserve the existing authorization mixin pattern in backend/main.mo for access control
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts
Use the existing ProfileSetupModal and AdminSetupNotice components without breaking their current functionality
Maintain compatibility with the existing shopping cart, orders, and invoices system
All admin features must be protected by proper access control checks
nonGoals: Real-time server monitoring or live status updates
Automated server provisioning or integration with cloud providers
Customer support chat or ticketing system
Email notifications for payment or server events
Multi-currency support beyond what Stripe provides
